sentences.en: Governments should not be in the business of legislating morality.
sentences.zh: 政府不应该涉足立法道德。

sentences.en: This is a sign of decreasing morality in this country.
sentences.zh: 这标志着这个国家道德水平的下降。

sentences.en: Morality is simply the attitude we adopt toward people we dislike.
sentences.zh: 道德仅仅是我们对待不喜欢的人的态度。

senses.zh: 道德,道德准则,品德高尚的行为,道德观
